findings.highlight: Servants are magics that summon heroic spirits
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは英霊を召喚して使役する魔術なんだろ
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands the Servant system as magecraft that summons and employs Heroic Spirits.
findings.explanation: Calling the summoned beings “magics” confuses the Servants with the summoning system.

findings.highlight: Thenyou have a real name
findings.evidenceJa: ならセイバーは
findings.governingReading: Shirou continues from the class name to Saber’s true name.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses Then and you.

findings.highlight: why I am here in this time
findings.evidenceJa: この時代における私の存在意義
findings.governingReading: Saber denotes the significance or function of her existence in the present age.
findings.explanation: Why I am here shifts a class-defined mode of existence toward a causal reason for her presence.

findings.highlight: It is not a name to represent my real identity.
findings.evidenceJa: シロウのような、個人を示す名称ではありません
findings.governingReading: Unlike Shirou, Saber is not a name identifying an individual.
findings.explanation: The comparison with Shirou’s personal name disappears, weakening the setup for the later address scene.

findings.highlight: Master and Servant are one.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとサーヴァントは一心同体
findings.governingReading: Master and Servant form one body and mind for purposes of combat trust.
findings.explanation: The idiom is reduced to abstract oneness, weakening the functional interdependence behind the secrecy argument.

findings.highlight: Most of all, I don’t care about it.
findings.evidenceJa: なによりあまり興味がなかった
findings.governingReading: Above all, Shirou is not especially interested in Saber’s true identity.
findings.explanation: Don’t care is more dismissive than limited curiosity and hardens his voice toward Saber.

findings.highlight: That’s bit unexpected.
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと意外だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds Saber’s human reaction a little unexpected.
findings.explanation: The required article is missing.

findings.highlight: Your Master is weak like this, so I understand that you have to try everything.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターがこんなだからさ、セイバーが工夫しようとしているのは判るよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands why Saber is devising precautions given the sort of Master she has.
findings.explanation: The English turns his inadequacy into generic weakness and her tactical ingenuity into trying everything.

findings.highlight: Andfrom my point of view, you aren’t inferior.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺から見たら、セイバーは全然負けてない
findings.governingReading: From Shirou’s perspective Saber is not losing to Berserker at all.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses And and from.

findings.highlight: I suffered defeat last night
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜は不覚をとりましたが
findings.governingReading: Saber admits she was caught at a disadvantage or suffered a lapse the previous night.
findings.explanation: Defeat overstates the result of a fight she survived and distorts the later distinction between wounds and losing outright.

findings.highlight: The Still, the unexpected invader mercilessly continues the discussion.
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく話を進めていくトンデモ侵略者
findings.governingReading: The outrageous invader presses the matter forward without mercy.
findings.explanation: A stray “The Still” corrupts the sentence.

findings.highlight: Ahhold on
findings.evidenceJa: あいや、待った
findings.governingReading: Shirou blurts an interrupted objection and tells Rin to wait.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses Ah and hold.

findings.highlight: if just one bed is no problem for you
findings.evidenceJa: 布団一組あればノープロブレム
findings.governingReading: Rin jokes that one futon set would suffice.
findings.explanation: Bed removes the Japanese bedding arrangement that enables the joke about sharing one futon.

findings.highlight: What are you saying while I’m not saying anything!?
findings.evidenceJa: 人が黙ってると思ってなに言いだすんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou protests that Rin is taking advantage of his silence to say outrageous things.
findings.explanation: The literal construction does not express the idiom’s accusation and reads as accidental non-English.

findings.highlight: Since when did you start calling me by my name?
findings.evidenceJa: いつのまに俺を名前で呼び捨てるようになってんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou notices that Rin has begun addressing him by his bare given name.
findings.explanation: By my name omits both given-name status and the dropped honorific, erasing the intimacy change under discussion.

findings.highlight: the matter of the room for Shirou and I
findings.evidenceJa: 私とシロウの部屋について
findings.governingReading: Saber returns to the question of her room with Shirou.
findings.explanation: The object of for incorrectly uses I instead of me.

findings.highlight: Shirou only said it would trouble him, and he did not say he did not want it.
findings.evidenceJa: シロウは困ると言っただけで、嫌だとは言っていない
findings.governingReading: Saber distinguishes Shirou being troubled from actively disliking the arrangement.
findings.explanation: Did not want it shifts 嫌 from dislike or aversion to volition, weakening the comic semantic distinction.

findings.highlight: calling me Shirou like I’m a cat she found
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎シロウと拾ってきた猫みたいに連呼するのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts to Rin and Saber repeatedly using differently written forms of his given name as though calling a stray cat.
findings.explanation: Rendering both written forms identically removes the two-speaker name contrast that powers the observation.

findings.highlight: I breathe out hard and intimidate Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: ふー、とうなってセイバーを威嚇する
findings.governingReading: Shirou growls or huffs theatrically to threaten Saber.
findings.explanation: The English states hard breathing and a successful intimidation, losing the performed comic action.

findings.highlight: a boundary field that alerts us if an enemy enters
findings.evidenceJa: 外敵が侵入すると警報が鳴る結界
findings.governingReading: The bounded field sounds an alarm when an outside intruder enters.
findings.explanation: Enemy narrows the detection condition and can imply that the field determines hostile status.

findings.highlight: She pronounces the “Emiya-kun” ostentatiously.
findings.evidenceJa: これみよがしに“衛宮くん”なんて発音する
findings.governingReading: Rin pointedly switches back to “Emiya-kun” so Shirou cannot miss the jab.
findings.explanation: Ostentatiously is dictionary-near but does not clearly convey the deliberate address reversal.

findings.highlight: Her actions are so selfish we just see her off with blank amazement. Perhaps because her actions are so selfish. Saber and I just see her off with blank amazement.
findings.evidenceJa: あまりの唯我独尊ぶりに、二人して呆然と見送ってしまった
findings.governingReading: Rin’s extreme self-centeredness leaves Shirou and Saber staring after her in stunned silence.
findings.explanation: Two alternative renderings are printed consecutively, duplicating the sentence and damaging the beat.

findings.highlight: if you follow the open corridor
findings.evidenceJa: 縁側をずっと歩いて
findings.governingReading: Shirou directs Saber along the engawa to the detached guest wing.
findings.explanation: Open corridor replaces the specific house feature and weakens the spatial layout.

findings.highlight: Whathis is Shirou’s room?
findings.evidenceJa: なこれがシロウの部屋、ですか？
findings.governingReading: Saber stumbles in surprise: “Th-this is your room?”
findings.explanation: The false start is corrupted into the fused form Whathis.

findings.highlight: I thought you were a more assorted person.
findings.evidenceJa: もっと雑多な人となりだと思っていました
findings.governingReading: Saber expected Shirou to have a more cluttered or miscellaneous cast of personality.
findings.explanation: Assorted person is a dictionary-near phrase that does not function naturally in English.

findings.highlight: touches the wall to check the feel of it
findings.evidenceJa: 壁や襖に手をあてて感触を確かめる
findings.governingReading: Saber places her hands on both walls and sliding panels to test their feel.
findings.explanation: The fusuma and plural exploration disappear, reducing the room-specific action.

findings.highlight: as if she understands the object’s memory just by touching it
findings.evidenceJa: その思い出を感じ取れるかのような優しい仕草
findings.governingReading: Her gentle gesture looks as though she could feel the memories held by what she touches.
findings.explanation: Understands the object’s memory makes the poetic comparison sound like a defined psychometric ability.

findings.highlight: this will not change my impression of you now
findings.evidenceJa: 今までの印象とそう変わりはしないでしょう
findings.governingReading: The room reassures Saber that Shirou is not very different from the impression she has formed until now.
findings.explanation: The English makes the room fail to change a present impression rather than confirm her prior reading of him.

findings.highlight: The spiritual connection we ought to have is not present.
findings.evidenceJa: 本来繋がっている筈の霊脈が断線している
findings.governingReading: The spiritual channel that should connect Master and Servant is physically described as severed or disconnected.
findings.explanation: A technical broken-line condition becomes a generic absent connection.

findings.highlight: I used about ten mature magi’s worth of magical energy last night.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜までで成熟した魔術師十人分の魔力は消費したでしょう
findings.governingReading: By the end of last night, Saber estimates that all post-summoning combat and healing consumed roughly ten mature magi’s worth.
findings.explanation: Last night narrows the cumulative endpoint into a single-night duration.

findings.highlight: If she already used up that much magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 既にそれだけの魔力を消費したのなら
findings.governingReading: If Saber has already consumed that quantity of magical energy, Shirou wonders how long she can remain.
findings.explanation: Used up can imply exhausting the entire reserve, conflicting with her continued manifestation.

findings.highlight: most of all, I have my own life as well
findings.evidenceJa: こっちにだって都合ってもんがある
findings.governingReading: Shirou also has practical circumstances of his own that prevent immediate agreement.
findings.explanation: Most of all invents a hierarchy, while life broadens the concrete scheduling concern.

findings.highlight: those with inhuman attitudes
findings.evidenceJa: 人としての節度を外したヤツ
findings.governingReading: Shirou will fight people who step outside the bounds of human decency or restraint.
findings.explanation: Inhuman attitudes describes a disposition rather than a breach of behavioral limits.

findings.highlight: the five remaining Mastersif they all have humane attitudes
findings.evidenceJa: あと五人残りの奴らがマトモなら
findings.governingReading: If the five remaining Masters are decent, Shirou will not initiate combat.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses Masters and if.

findings.highlight: heroic spirits that attribute to several classes
findings.evidenceJa: 複数のクラス属性を持つ英霊もいる
findings.governingReading: Some Heroic Spirits possess affinities or qualifications for multiple classes.
findings.explanation: Attribute to is grammatically malformed and obscures class eligibility.

findings.highlight: She was flawless last time
findings.evidenceJa: 以前は万全だったのに
findings.governingReading: Previously Saber fought in full condition, unlike her present restrictions.
findings.explanation: Flawless recasts adequate condition as a claim that her past performance had no faults.

findings.highlight: The image of a girl smaller than me, covered miserably in blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 無惨にも傷ついた映像
findings.governingReading: The image fixed in Shirou’s mind is the smaller, slight girl grievously wounded.
findings.explanation: Covered in blood preserves appearance but drops the injury itself, weakening the cause of his guilt.

findings.highlight: such regret is useless
findings.evidenceJa: その後悔は、余分な事です
findings.governingReading: Saber tells Shirou that his regret is unnecessary or superfluous.
findings.explanation: Useless disparages the feeling’s utility and makes her reply colder.

findings.highlight: When I raise my head, Saber’s expression is serious.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの声で我に返る
findings.governingReading: Saber’s voice brings Shirou back to himself.
findings.explanation: The English adds a head movement and a serious expression absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: That’strue.
findings.evidenceJa: それはそうだけど
findings.governingReading: Shirou concedes the point before asking whether Saber accepts injury.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses That’s and true.

findings.highlight: I just consider her words in my mind.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの言葉を噛みしめていた
findings.governingReading: Unable to call after her, Shirou stands alone and chews over Saber’s words.
findings.explanation: The generic consider loses the prolonged, almost physical rumination that closes the scene.
